mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.built_in DESC, r.role_name

SELECT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.sort_order
SELECT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rp.role_id IN
#{roleId}
